title: Temporary file created without owner-only permissions (java)
description: java code creates a temporary file (File.createTempFile). On a shared host the default permissions can let another account read the file, and a predictable name lets it be pre-created as a symlink. This lexical rule flags the creation; the reviewer confirms the permissions and the name source.
remediation: Create the file with owner-only permissions and a random name, for example Files.createTempFile with POSIX owner-only permissions, and delete it in a finally block.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: flags temp-file creation without inspecting the resulting permissions.
